items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Freddie, whatever his name, I can't remember his name, saved my life. He was the original banjo player in that band. Then Fliver Ford took his place.

ctx.x: Yeah. So everybody called him Fliver. One of the funniest characters that I ever knew in my life. He was a constant laugh. Died very young, dropped dead. J.B. Landry was in the band. Freddie, some played banjo.
